problem: How many pizzas did each family get? After the party, 30 pizzas were left over, so the host divided them equally among 3 families.
follow_up_questions: One family cut each of its pizzas in half before freezing them. How many pieces did that family have?

problem: Farmer Kaya has 4 sacks to fill with the potatoes from 3 rows of her field, and each row gave 28 potatoes. She puts the same number in every sack. How many potatoes go in a sack?
follow_up_questions: She takes one sack to the market and sells 15 of its potatoes. How many potatoes are left in that sack?
Each potato sold for 3 dollars. How much money did she make at the market?
She shares the money equally among her 5 grandchildren. How much does each grandchild get?

problem: How many books does each box hold? A school packs 3 shelves of books, 28 books per shelf, into 4 boxes with the same number in each.
follow_up_questions: One box goes to a charity sale, where 15 of its books are sold. How many books are left in that box?
Each book sold for 3 dollars. How much money did the sale bring in?
The money is shared equally among 5 class trips. How much does each class trip get?

problem: Two teachers share the job of sorting 24 board games equally. How many games does each teacher sort?
follow_up_questions: Checking one game takes 5 minutes. How many minutes does one teacher spend checking?
Of one teacher's games, 3 were broken and thrown away. How many of that teacher's games were kept?

problem: How many bikes does each mechanic fix? A bike shop has 24 bikes to repair, and the job is split evenly between 2 mechanics.
follow_up_questions: Looking over one bike takes 5 minutes. How many minutes does one mechanic spend looking over bikes?
Of one mechanic's bikes, 3 could not be fixed and were sold for parts. How many of that mechanic's bikes were fixed?

problem: Three schools tied for first place at the spelling contest, so the judge split 27 prize books equally among them. The hall was decorated with flags. How many prize books did each school get?
follow_up_questions: Each school had 11 spellers. How many spellers in a school did not get a book?

problem: How many ribbons did each team win? The rain stopped just before the relay. In the end, 27 ribbons were divided equally between the 3 fastest teams.
follow_up_questions: Each team had 11 runners. How many runners on a team went without a ribbon?

problem: Four tables at an art course share some crayons equally: the teacher ordered 8 boxes with 12 crayons in each. The course runs for 5 days. How many crayons does each table get?
How many eggs does each kitchen receive? A hotel with 5 floors ordered 8 trays of eggs, with 12 eggs on every tray, and splits them equally among its 4 kitchens.
A library shared 20 free reading lamps equally between 5 reading groups. How many lamps did each group get?
follow_up_questions: Each group had 9 children. How many children in a group still need a lamp?
A lamp costs 3 dollars. How much would it cost to buy lamps for those children in one group?

problem: How many helmets did each class receive? The cycling club donated 20 helmets, sharing them evenly between 5 classes.
follow_up_questions: There are 9 pupils in each class. How many pupils in a class still need a helmet?
Helmets cost 3 dollars each at the club sale. How much would helmets for those pupils in one class cost?

problem: A gardener splits 80 litres of rainwater equally among 4 watering tanks. How many litres does each tank get?
follow_up_questions: She uses 3 litres from one tank. How many litres are left in that tank?

problem: How many buckets of sand go into each sandpit? A builder tips 80 buckets of sand into 4 sandpits at the playground, the same amount in each.
follow_up_questions: Children carry 3 buckets of sand out of one sandpit. How many buckets of sand are left in it?

problem: There are 7 hamster cages at the pet shop where Pedro helps, and he shares 49 food pellets equally among them. How many pellets go into each cage?
follow_up_questions: Next he feeds the gerbils, giving each gerbil cage 2 pellets fewer than a hamster cage. How many pellets does each gerbil cage get?
There are 6 gerbil cages. How many pellets does he use for them all?
How many pellets did Pedro use for the hamsters and gerbils together?

problem: How many scoops of seed does each feeder get? At the nature centre, Gita divides 49 scoops equally among 7 bird feeders.
follow_up_questions: Then she fills the squirrel boxes, giving each box 2 scoops fewer than a feeder. How many scoops does each squirrel box get?
There are 6 squirrel boxes. How many scoops go into all of them?
How many scoops did Gita use for the feeders and squirrel boxes together?

problem: The zoo shop has 4 tills and wants the same number of tiger keyrings beside each one. It has 76 keyrings. How many keyrings go beside each till?
follow_up_questions: One till sells 7 keyrings before lunch. How many keyrings are left beside it?

problem: How many postcards does each stand get? A castle gift shop has 76 postcards and shares them out equally among 4 stands.
follow_up_questions: One stand sells 7 postcards in the morning. How many postcards are left at that stand?

problem: Elena puts her 40 trading cards into a folder with 5 pockets, the same number in every pocket. She got the folder when she turned 10. How many cards are in each pocket?
follow_up_questions: She gives one full pocket to her cousin. How many cards does Elena have left?
She moves the cards she has left into 4 tins, the same number in each. How many cards go in each tin?

problem: How many crayons are in each cup when Bilal, aged 7, divides his 40 crayons equally among 5 cups?
follow_up_questions: He gives one full cup to his little brother. How many crayons does Bilal have left?
He puts his remaining crayons into 4 pencil cases, the same number in each. How many crayons go in each case?

problem: The workshop smelled of fresh sawdust. Uncle Farid shared 12 wooden boards equally among the 4 bird boxes he was building for his nieces. How many boards did each bird box use?
How many eggs are in each nest? A farmer finds 12 eggs spread equally across 4 nests in the barn. A cat was sleeping on the hay.
Four pupils took turns at the lemonade stall and sold 92 cups between them, each selling the same number. Find how many cups each pupil sold.
follow_up_questions: The stall had 99 cups ready at the start. How many cups were not sold?

problem: How many tickets did each seller sell? At the football match, 92 raffle tickets were sold by 4 sellers, who all sold the same amount.
follow_up_questions: The sellers started with 99 tickets. How many tickets were left unsold?

problem: A pizzeria delivers 18 pizzas to a youth club with 6 teams, and the pizzas are split equally among the teams. How many pizzas does each team get?
follow_up_questions: Each pizza is cut into 8 slices. How many slices does one team get?
One team eats 10 slices at lunch. How many slices are left for later?

problem: How many cakes does each class get when a baker shares 18 cakes equally among 6 classes?
follow_up_questions: Every cake is cut into 8 pieces. How many pieces does one class get?
One class eats 10 pieces at break time. How many pieces are left for the afternoon?

problem: The farmer collected 80 cups of milk from her 10 goats this evening, the same amount from each goat. How many cups did one goat give?
follow_up_questions: Each cup fills 2 tiny jars. How many jars does one goat's milk fill?
Out of one goat's jars, 4 are given to the farm dog. How many jars are left?
The rest are packed into boxes that hold 6 jars each. How many boxes are filled?

problem: How many litres of juice does each machine make? A factory's 10 machines made 80 litres of juice today, and each machine made the same amount.
follow_up_questions: Each litre fills 2 bottles. How many bottles does one machine's juice fill?
From one machine's bottles, 4 are kept for testing. How many bottles are left?
The remaining bottles go into packs of 6. How many packs are filled?

problem: Three small toy shops in town will share 81 board games equally from the main store, which has 2 entrances. How many board games does each small shop get?
follow_up_questions: One small shop already has 19 board games. How many does it have after the delivery?

problem: How many computers will each school get? A company with 2 offices is giving away 81 old computers, shared equally among 3 schools.
follow_up_questions: One school already owns 19 computers. How many will it have after the gift?

problem: Seven runners each ran the same distance in a relay, and together they covered 70 laps. How many laps did each runner run?
How many points did each player score if 7 players in a quiz team scored 70 points in total and all scored equally?
Gardeners place 36 new flowerpots evenly along the 4 sides of the town square. The old pots had cracked in the winter frost. How many flowerpots stand on each side?
follow_up_questions: On one side, 3 pots are moved into the shade of a tree. How many pots are left in the sun on that side?

problem: How many lanterns hang on each side of the courtyard? Workers spread 36 lanterns evenly across its 4 sides. Birds were singing in the fountain.
follow_up_questions: On one side, 3 lanterns are taken down for repair. How many lanterns are still hanging on that side?

problem: Six horse stalls share the oats from 2 bags equally, and each bag weighs 45 kilograms. How many kilograms of oats does each stall get?
follow_up_questions: The horse in one stall eats 3 kilograms a day. How many days will its oats last?
Then the groom adds 9 more kilograms to that stall's oats. How many days will the oats last now?

problem: How many kilograms of soil does each flower bed receive? A gardener has 2 sacks of soil, 45 kilograms in each, and spreads all of it equally over 6 flower beds.
follow_up_questions: A bed uses 3 kilograms of soil for every plant. How many plants can one bed's soil cover?
The gardener adds 9 kilograms more to that bed. How many plants can its soil cover now?

problem: Kept warm at 25 degrees, the butterfly house holds 35 butterflies shared equally among its 5 glass cases. How many butterflies live in one case?
How many goldfish swim in each bowl? A pet shop puts 35 goldfish into 5 bowls in equal numbers, and the shop opened 20 years ago.
Nine pupils share 90 Lego bricks equally to build their own cars. How many bricks does each pupil use?
follow_up_questions: One pupil's car crashes, and 4 bricks roll under a cupboard. How many bricks are left in that car?

problem: How many dominoes does each player get when 90 dominoes are dealt equally to 9 players?
follow_up_questions: One player drops 4 dominoes behind the sofa. How many does that player still have?

problem: Eight children ordered star stickers. The shop owner had 2 rolls with 48 stickers per roll and shared all of them equally among the children. How many stickers did each child get?
follow_up_questions: One child uses 5 of her stickers on a notebook. How many does she have left?
Her brother has 3 times as many stickers as she has left. How many does her brother have?
Her brother lines up his stickers in 7 equal rows. How many stickers are in each row?

problem: How many tickets does each family get? A theatre has 2 blocks of tickets with 48 tickets in each block and gives them all out equally to 8 families.
follow_up_questions: One family gives 5 of its tickets to friends. How many tickets does it have left?
Another family has 3 times as many tickets as that family has left. How many tickets does it have?
The other family's tickets are for 7 rows, with the same number in each row. How many tickets are for each row?

problem: After the sack race, 5 winners shared 20 popcorn tokens equally. How many tokens did each winner get?
follow_up_questions: Each winner spent 3 tokens on popcorn. How many tokens did each winner have left?
The winners put all their leftover tokens together. How many tokens is that?

problem: How many stickers did each helper receive? A teacher handed out 20 gold stickers so that her 5 best helpers each got the same number.
follow_up_questions: Each helper stuck 3 stickers on a chart. How many stickers did each helper still have?
The helpers collected their remaining stickers in one jar. How many stickers are in the jar?

problem: The farmer split 16 roof tiles evenly between his 2 sons so they could patch the leaky barn. Nobody knew how old the barn was. How many tiles did each son get?
follow_up_questions: Each son needed 10 tiles. How many more tiles did each son need?

problem: How many paint pots did each painter get? The school mural was fading. A teacher divided 16 pots of paint equally between 2 painters.
follow_up_questions: Each painter needed 10 pots. How many more pots did each painter need?

problem: Over 6 weeks, a cafe uses up 4 sacks of coffee beans, each weighing 18 kilograms, using the same amount every week. The cafe opens at 7 each morning. How many kilograms of beans does it use per week?
How many kilograms of rice does the camp kitchen cook each day? The kitchen has 4 bags of rice weighing 18 kilograms each, uses it all in equal amounts over 6 days, and feeds 50 campers.
Maya shares 24 scoops of feed equally among her 3 pigs at supper time. How many scoops does each pig get?
follow_up_questions: The smallest pig is unwell and eats only half of its feed. How many scoops does it eat?
Maya puts the feed it did not eat back in the sack. How many scoops did the pigs eat altogether?

problem: How many spoonfuls of food does each cat get? At a cat cafe, 24 spoonfuls of food are shared equally by 3 cats.
follow_up_questions: The oldest cat eats just half of its spoonfuls. How many spoonfuls does it eat?
The food it left is thrown away. How many spoonfuls did the cats eat altogether?

problem: A teacher shares 14 new atlases equally among the 7 group tables in her classroom. How many atlases does each table get?
follow_up_questions: Each table seats 6 pupils. If they share the table's atlases equally, how many pupils share one atlas?

problem: How many tablets are on each desk when 14 tablets are spread equally over 7 desks in the computer room?
follow_up_questions: Each desk has 6 children. If they share the desk's tablets equally, how many children share one tablet?

problem: Six activity stations are set up in the gym, and the PE teacher shares 18 hoops equally among them. What number of hoops does each station get?
follow_up_questions: Each hoop is used 4 times at a station during the lesson. How many uses happen at one station?
The lesson is repeated twice. How many uses happen at one station in total?
How many uses is that across all the stations?

problem: How many beanbags does each team get? For a game, a coach divides 18 beanbags evenly among 6 teams.
follow_up_questions: Each beanbag is thrown 4 times by its team. How many throws does one team make?
The game is played twice. How many throws does one team make altogether?
How many throws is that for all the teams?

problem: The choir's 8 singers will share their fundraising money equally. A bake sale brought in 58 dollars and a car wash brought in 38 dollars. How many dollars does each singer get to spend?
follow_up_questions: One singer buys a folder for 5 dollars. How much of that singer's share is left?

problem: How much money does each scout get? A troop of 8 scouts earned 58 dollars raking leaves and 38 dollars washing dogs, and they split it all equally.
follow_up_questions: One scout spends 5 dollars on a torch. How much of his share is left?

problem: A librarian sorts 30 magazines into 6 equal piles on the reading table, finishing before the doors open at 10. How many magazines are in each pile?
follow_up_questions: A reading group takes 2 piles. How many magazines does the group take?
How many magazines are left on the table?

problem: How many mats are in each stack? The gym teacher, who arrives at 8 each day, divides 30 mats into 6 equal stacks.
follow_up_questions: A class borrows 2 stacks. How many mats does the class borrow?
How many mats remain in the gym?

problem: Worms wriggled in the damp soil. A teacher shared 15 new trowels equally among the 5 groups working in the school garden. How many trowels did each group get?
How many feeders does each pen get? The farm put up 15 new feeders, shared equally among 5 sheep pens. The sheep crowded around them at once.
Gardeners plant 8 equal flower beds using 3 trays of seedlings with 32 seedlings in each tray. How many seedlings go in each bed?
follow_up_questions: Every seedling grows 5 flowers. How many flowers grow in one bed?

problem: How many candles go on each table? A hotel has 3 boxes of candles, 32 in each box, and spreads them over 8 tables equally.
follow_up_questions: Each candle burns for 5 hours. How many hours of candlelight does one table get?

problem: Eight scout clubs visited the zoo on its open day and shared 72 badges equally. How many badges did one club get?
follow_up_questions: One club gave 4 of its badges to the keeper who showed them around. How many badges did that club keep?
The keeper got the same gift from 3 clubs. How many badges did he get in all?

problem: How many pencils did each team receive? At the science fair, organisers gave out 72 pencils, sharing them equally among 8 teams.
follow_up_questions: One team gave 4 pencils to a judge as a thank-you. How many pencils did that team keep?
The judge got the same gift from 3 teams. How many pencils did she get altogether?

problem: Sara plants 32 young apple trees across 4 fields of her orchard, the same number in every field. How many trees go into each field?
follow_up_questions: Deer eat 3 trees in one field. How many are left in that field?
Sara replaces the 3 eaten trees and plants 2 extra as well. How many trees are in that field now?
How many more trees does that field have than each of the other fields?

problem: How many fish go into each pond? A park keeper has 32 goldfish to share equally among 4 ponds.
follow_up_questions: A heron catches 3 fish from one pond. How many fish are left in that pond?
The keeper puts in 3 new fish to replace them and adds 2 more as well. How many fish are in that pond now?
How many more fish does that pond have than each of the other ponds?
